list.name: open 2 sentences
list.word: The lazy student will do his final paper later.
A tiger is silent as it hunts.
That super pilot is a local hero.
The poker game will begin later.
I will tell you a tiny secret later.
The hotel is covered in ivy.
The lady gave me bacon and gravy.
That diver is in the navy.
There is a tiny female spider in the ivy.
There is a poker event at the local hotel.
